value.meaning: a cost profile exists under which the toll is small relative to the typical move available at the strategy's own horizon; it is a *cost* finding and says nothing about whether any edge exists
value.note: no strategy is proposed, no hypothesis is created and no gate is reopened by this recommendation; the owner must authorize any next step

profile.execution: market/taker on both legs (the cheapest permitted posture at VIP0)
profile.horizon_region: holding periods from about one day upwards, where the measured median move is at least seven times the toll
profile.turnover_region: low: each round trip costs 0.467071068 USDT at full deployment, so the annual toll is roughly 0.852 x capital per round trip per day

violated_if: realised round-trip cost exceeds the modelled toll: every extra bps of realised cost is an extra bps of required gross edge, and ST-6 halts the campaign on exactly that
the forward spread measurement contradicts the modelled 1.0 bps (SRC-07 has no historical endpoint, so the estimate is unverified until then)
a candidate's holding horizon is shorter than its own measured cost-compatible region
